focus: Adaptive Hierarchical Depth Selection via Capability Composition
question: Will a prospectively deployed adaptive depth‑selection policy, derived offline by selecting the depth that minimized observed error for each horizon, achieve a lower average planning error than the best single static depth policy on a held‑out set of planning tasks?
hypothesis: When evaluated on a held‑out set of planning tasks, the adaptive policy will produce a statistically lower average planning error than the best static depth policy identified from the same observational data, yielding a positive approximated G_A (difference in expected utility between the two interventions).
next_action: Execute the hypothesis_ablation experiment comparing adaptive vs static depth policies on the held‑out planning task set.
